cases.question: Toy Python mapping: d has key x with value 7. Evaluate d.get("missing", 9).
evidence: Mapping.get returns the stored value when the key exists, otherwise the supplied default.

cases.question: Toy Python mapping: d has key x with value 7. Evaluate d.get("x", 9).
evidence: Mapping.get returns the stored value when the key exists, otherwise the supplied default.
